parsed.notes:
The introductory 'We work with' sentence is treated literally as company description, not a dedicated tech-stack section; AWS is therefore excluded.
PREFERRED SKILLS is optional; all other qualification and skills sections default to required. Required mentions override preferred repetitions.
Terraform and Ansible are examples for the single infrastructure-as-code ask and form an alternative group. The SRE/DevOps/Platform Engineering alternatives have only one mapped taxonomy member, so no mapped group is emitted.
ML frameworks, debugging, storage, and HPC are retained as unmapped rather than inferred to be Machine Learning, Software Testing, Object Storage, or another broader or narrower taxonomy skill.
ML systems deployment is provisionally mapped to AI deployment; it could instead mean infrastructure deployment rather than model deployment. Its 'Ideally' marker makes it optional.
The title contains 'Staff', which the guide identifies as senior; flagged because 'Member of Technical Staff' can also be a level-neutral title. The optional 3-5 years phrase would otherwise support mid.
